name: ramus
description: Give Claude Code a disposable cloud Android emulator. Run an APK, demo app or GitHub pull request build, then snapshot the screen, tap, type, read logs and share a live link. Requires a Ramus account or a free CLI trial.

api_key.title: Ramus API key
api_key.description: Create one at https://ramus.dev/settings. Optional: without it the android-use skill can start a 60-minute CLI trial, but the MCP tools need a key.
